Initial release of Lead Magnet Builder — an all-in-one prompt-flow for creating and delivering high-converting lead magnets.

- Designs lead magnets (checklists, templates, guides, quizzes, toolkits) tailored to your audience and goals
- Includes three output sections: lead magnet content, landing page copy, and delivery email
- Ensures best practices for compliance, value clarity, and audience fit
- Offers format selection guidance with templates for various lead magnet types
- Provides nurture email #2 suggestions for ongoing engagement
